nodes.notes: Connect OpenAI here for the full documentary structure. Return title candidates, hook, promise, CTA and 8 chapters with retention purpose.

nodes.name: Script LLM Placeholder
nodes.notes: Connect OpenAI here for the long-form English script. Return title, description, tags, intro, chapter narration, outro and monetization notes.

nodes.name: Voiceover Placeholder
nodes.notes: Connect ElevenLabs TTS here. Generate audio chapter by chapter to control retries, pacing and expressive emphasis.

nodes.name: Background Music Placeholder
nodes.notes: Connect Eleven Music here. Generate instrumental underscore only, no vocals, and keep it editorial rather than trailer-heavy.

nodes.name: Subtitle Timing Placeholder
nodes.notes: Connect OpenAI speech-to-text here to transcribe the final voiceover and get word-level timestamps for animated captions.

nodes.name: Render Placeholder
nodes.notes: Connect Creatomate here. The template should combine voiceover, background music, word-level captions, chapter cards, lower thirds and restrained transitions.
